questions.question: What is the main purpose of the system parameter in a Messages API request?

options.text: To provide high-level behavior and instructions for Claude
To store the user's conversation permanently
To execute JavaScript before the model runs
To configure the network timeout only

questions.explanation: System instructions establish the assistant's role, priorities, constraints, and general behavior. They do not replace user messages or enforce application-side security controls.

questions.question: Which of the following are types of AI agents? (Select all that apply)
questions.explanation: Reflex, goal-based, and utility-based agents are established AI agent categories. A reflex agent selects actions according to the current percept and predefined rules. A goal-based agent considers desired goals when deciding which actions to take. A utility-based agent evaluates possible outcomes using a utility function and attempts to select actions that maximize the expected utility. 'Database agent' is not a standard agent category in this classification, although AI agents can certainly use databases as tools or knowledge sources.

questions.question: A request fails because the application sends an unsupported model identifier. What should you do first?

options.text: Verify the model ID against current Anthropic documentation and account availability
Increase max_tokens to the largest possible value

questions.explanation: Model identifiers and availability can change. Verify the exact supported identifier and access for the chosen API provider before changing unrelated request parameters.
